title: Custom futsal & 5-a-side jerseys
meta_descript: Custom futsal and 5-a-side jerseys: lighter fabric for the indoor game, printed names, numbers and sponsors, every size. No minimum order.
content:
Quick answer

For futsal and 5-a-side, MOMUTO makes lighter, custom kits — your colours, crest and numbers — in breathable polyester/elastane with full dye-sublimation, no minimum order. Draft in 24–48 h, delivery in 25–30 days.

Kits built for the indoor game

Futsal and 5-a-side are faster, tighter, sweatier. A sublimated polyester/elastane jersey wicks moisture and moves with you — no heavy transfers, no cracked prints. Start from the free 3D configurator or send a concept to a designer.

Small squads, no minimum order

A futsal roster is small — often 8 to 12 players. There is no minimum order, so you kit exactly the players you have, from kids’ XS to adult 4XL. Size guide.

Numbers, names and a sponsor

Names, numbers and a local sponsor are printed into the fabric at no extra cost. Pick a strong two-colour base so numbers read clearly under indoor lighting — see the colour guide.

Frequently asked questions

Can I order just 8 futsal jerseys?

Yes — there is no minimum order. You can order from one jersey up to a full roster; the per-jersey price drops with quantity.

Is the fabric different from an outdoor kit?

Same polyester/elastane base built for breathability and movement, ideal for the indoor game. Full sublimation keeps the print flat and durable.

Can we add player names and numbers?

Yes, printed into the fabric — names, numbers and sponsors, with no peeling.
